svg.title: HomeBrain Presence Motherboard
svg.text: HOMEBRAIN PRESENCE MOTHERBOARD — V1.2-DRAFT DIRECT-SOLDER ASSEMBLY
One dedicated PCB • factory male headers solder through labeled footprints • no inter-module wire harnesses
J1
J2
J3
XIAO
USB-C
THE ELECTRICAL CONNECTIONS ARE COPPER TRACES
Colored routes are visualization only; the finished assembly contains no loose sensor wiring.
Direct-solder footprints
U1 XIAO: insert both factory 1x7 headers; solder underside, inspect, then trim.
J1 DIYables DHT11
+=D3 • OUT=D2 • -=GND
vertical; insert factory-installed 1x3 male header through J1, solder from the motherboard underside,
inspect, then trim; blue sensor rises from the board and printed + OUT - faces inward
J2 HiLetgo VEML7700
VIN=3V3 • 3Vo=NC_VEML_3VO • GND=GND • SCL=SCL • SDA=SDA
parallel, component side up; insert factory-installed 1x5 male header through J2, solder from the
motherboard underside, inspect, then trim; light sensor above header
J3 Hi-Link LD2410C
TX=RX • RX=TX • OUT=NC_RADAR_OUT • GND=GND • VCC=VBUS
parallel, antenna face up; insert factory-installed 1x5 male header through J3, solder from the motherboard
underside, inspect, then trim; module overhangs right PCB edge; verify enclosure antenna-face clearance
Four 3.4 mm grounded mounting holes accept common #4 screws into printed plastic posts.
